Ace of Swords reversed, 5. The Hierophant reversed, 6. Death reversed, 7. The Fool upright, 8. Queen of Swords reversed, 9. King of Wands upright, 10. Six of Cups reversed

Position 2 (challenge): Nine of Swords upright - his anxiety and nightmares as obstacle, not lack of organ
Position 3 (future): Two of Pentacles upright - development into balanced juggling game beyond fixed attack/receive; cat born from this
Position 4 (past/root): Ace of Swords reversed - origin in his blocked truth, acting roles instead of expressing desire
Position 5 (goal/best): The Hierophant reversed - invent new non-traditional relationship form without fixed roles, including tree milk and cats
Position 6 (subconscious base): Death reversed - reluctance to end the game, questions prolong it
Position 7 (self-perception/advice): The Fool upright - advice to leap into unknown, abandon questions, jump to tree milk river with cats
Position 8 (environment/others): Queen of Swords reversed - others view as crazy, harsh judgment on concepts
Position 9 (hope/fear): King of Wands upright - hope he becomes mature fire leader, fear he remains stuck
Position 10 (outcome): Six of Cups reversed - exit illusion by outgrowing childhood game, carry cats forward
Tree milk nutrition table with components from each position, percentages, functions; 24/7 feasibility as byproduct of ongoing dialogue
